actions.text: Pressing Run on a scheduled task executes the command named by that task.
For a queued command, a remove button opens a confirmation ("Cancel" / "YesCancel" / "NoLeaveIt"); confirming cancels the command.

rules.text: The remove button appears only when the command status is queued.
Running the same command again within 5 seconds is ignored with a console warning.
The command list is refetched at a regular interval.

shows.text: The page is titled Tasks with the scope System and shows two sections: Scheduled, then Queue.
The Scheduled section shows a loading indicator while tasks load, and an error message "Error loading tasks: <message>" if loading fails.
When no scheduled tasks exist and loading has finished, the Scheduled section shows "No scheduled tasks found."
Each scheduled task row shows name, interval, last execution, last duration, next execution and a Run button.
A scheduled task with interval 0 shows "disabled" as its interval and "-" as next execution.
Next execution shows "queued" if the next execution time has passed and the command is queued, "now" if passed and not queued, otherwise the next execution time.
Last duration shows "-" unless the last start time is after 2010-01-01.
The Run button spins while the task's command is queued or started.
The Queue section shows a loading indicator while loading, and "Error loading commands" on error; otherwise a table of queued commands.
Each queue row shows a trigger icon (manual, scheduled or default), a status icon, the command name, and queued, started and ended times ("-" if missing), duration and actions.
The status icon differs for queued, started (spinning), completed (success, with message), failed (danger, with message) and unknown statuses.
The command name cell lists the related series titles sorted by sort title, shows the season number if present, and shows "From: <user agent>" when a client user agent exists.
When more than 11 series titles apply, the first 10 are listed followed by "N more".
Times display as relative or formatted dates according to the UI settings, and refresh after 30 seconds.

sideEffects.text: Running a task sends a POST to the command endpoint and adds or updates the returned command in the cached command list.
Cancelling sends a DELETE for the command id and removes it from the cached command list.
The page loads scheduled tasks from the system task endpoint and commands from the command endpoint.
